rows.what: Four named sea identities, map scope and shore material bindings
rows.why: delegated: The September packaging ruling keeps the bundle; the November floor/beach ruling defines its playable places. Existing sun extension and obsolete hydrology text require correction, not a new solar system.

rows.what: Scald floor: walkable nonboiling hot mineral substrate
rows.evidence: src/RimMandrake/TerminalBiomes/Defs/BiomeDefs/RM_TheScald.xml maps both floor fertility bands to boiling ocean terrain; src/RimMandrake/TerminalBiomes/Patches/RM_ScaldWater_LiquidHeat.xml marks both hot. Proposed RM_ScaldFloorSubstrate is absent.
rows.serves: Work outside the Scald hull on mineral ground at ambient heat
rows.why: delegated: The Scald sheet’s floor gentles to mere heat. Substrate replaces universal boiling-contact terrain and preserves shallow native mat habitat and usable working ground.

rows.what: Scald beach hot-spring comfort on boiling water and comfortable bathing at the cooler margin
rows.evidence: src/RimMandrake/TerminalBiomes/Defs/TerrainDefs/RM_ScaldWater.xml and src/RimMandrake/TerminalBiomes/Defs/TerrainDefs/RM_ScaldMargin.xml both bind the Odyssey HotSpring thought. The margin XML describes its ordinary swimming route.
rows.called_by: Odyssey terrain traversal consumes traversedThought, and ordinary JoyGiver_GoSwimming may use eligible margin cells where the shore adapter places them.
rows.serves: Scald land: the burn is also comforting and the margin permits bathing
rows.why: delegated: Removing comfort would defeat the Scald sheet’s explicit double truth and turn its baths into plain retreat ground. Use ordinary mood and recreation, with no ritual or quest.

rows.what: Scald beach steam sky, still spells, vent shapes and ambient breath
rows.serves: Recognisable beach weather above a calm submerged floor
rows.why: delegated: Steam and vents express the volcanic setting; they do not add a separate damage clock or floor sky. Beach delivery is required but not proven by a patch targeting a background sea biome.

rows.what: Grey mineral formations, brine channels, pools and shore salt domes
rows.serves: Crowded mineral floor, solitary life and readable pool danger
rows.why: delegated: These are the ground and resources, not an event or an alternate river signature. Removing their player-facing shape defeats the Grey setting.

rows.what: Grey salt-crystal fall weather
rows.why: delegated: It is the floor weather the owner described on September 26; removing its fall loses the visible source of the mineral setting. It never makes water snow, cold or rain.

rows.what: Chill floor ice, propane pools, rime terraces, cold and drowned aurora
rows.called_by: src/RimMandrake/DivingInteraction/Defs/MapGeneration/RM_SeaDiveGenStepDefs.xml registers the terraces; the floor map components apply aurora and oxygen state.
rows.serves: Visit a dark fuel lake floor rather than a snowfield
rows.why: delegated: Cold, oxygen-poor fuel and the pool/crust contrast are ordinary land. Terrace, aurora and floor support are implemented in DivingInteraction. T45 still needs composed runtime evidence with deferred shock and power harvesting inactive.

The current single-seeder loop independently selects a random cell for each pawn, so group-size declarations alone do not implement the required initial contrast. T51 addresses initial entry and later refill without changing the roster.

rows.what: Scald catch and living floor counterparts
rows.serves: Scald shore fishing and floor gathering
rows.why: delegated: The standing sea rule requires the living species behind fish-sized catches; giants need no catch. Industrial catches stay industrial and rare nonliving objects are not misclassified as fish.

rows.what: Mobile registration of natural creature light
rows.serves: Living light moves with the animal
rows.why: delegated: Without position-correct glow, an animal leaves light behind when it moves; that defeats the moving luminous fauna in C14. Keep this adapter independently of player light-farming.

rows.what: Waveglass lid, gold light columns and well lifecycle
rows.why: delegated: The frozen Twilight hard bans forbid permanent skylights. Keep minimal opening, standing, waning, closing and replacement; neither ownership nor a permanent floor mat stands in for the roof. The proposed default restores years-scale drift. Current week-scale source is implementation evidence for the existing version only.

rows.what: Living protected giant gardener visible far overhead under the Twilight waveglass
rows.called_by: Promised by Twilight lore; current WellLedger has a theatrical callback but no local living gardener caller was found.
rows.serves: The living roof has its keeper
rows.why: delegated: Removing the living creature while the roof persists violates the frozen no-roof-without-gardener ban and removes the giant from the Twilight’s ordinary view. Preserve the same living overhead animal across ordinary play and retained-floor visits. Defer interactive rim jobs and ceiling routing.
rows.needed_by: C20 / Twilight land / B2 and B7

rows.what: Current channel geometry, banks and sink, including ordinary undertow
rows.serves: Harvest beside water that carries you under
rows.why: delegated: Ordinary RM_BankSilt identifies the bank for C30’s unbuilt spawn bias. The intended forage advantage draws workers away from off-bank alternatives, including lit gardens. Current takes unsecured workers toward a recoverable sink. Removing the harvest advantage, carry or recovery breaks that chain. The silt-trap upgrade is a separate deferred mechanic.

rows.what: Undersurge widening and return to calm
rows.serves: The current changes the safe bank boundary
rows.why: delegated: This is the same carrying water extending its reach, not a second hazard. It must announce the boundary change and leave a usable route.

rows.what: Sink condition, readable location, rescue and recovery
rows.serves: Find and recover a colonist rather than losing a pawn silently
rows.why: delegated: Without a findable victim and rescue state, the current is an unexplained deletion. Default remains Recoverable; harsher options must still retain readable remains/signs.

rows.what: Float harness and generic ford/weir current arrest seams
rows.serves: A prepared worker can manage current risk
rows.why: delegated: The harness reduces carry, never grants free centre swimming; safe bank routes and existing FlowWorks arrest supply preparation/rescue without adding a cargo economy. No new weir or fertility engine is designed.

rows.what: Entry, surge, sink warnings and retained well inspection
rows.serves: Read danger before and after entering it
rows.why: delegated: Removing warnings defeats informed current use; removing well state text hides expiry. The lamp and crust inspection branches follow their deferred extras and cannot run by default.

rows.what: Master, per-sea, per-feature settings and persistence
rows.serves: Understand effective features and switch them off
rows.why: delegated: Standing Mod Settings floor; deleting the controls breaks a standing ruling. Disable behaviour, retain defs and safe travel, and label deferred content.

rows.what: Mixed-biome inert guard, scatter null guard and def alias compatibility
rows.called_by: Engine XML loading / biome roster consumption; no explicit local caller found
rows.serves: Keep native life and save references intact
rows.why: delegated: These are load/regression safeguards, not player extras or passing bars. Removing them can erase life or break an existing save even when an extra is off.

rows.what: Natural bank-forage advantage from weighted placement and refill of existing Twilight harvestable flora (the bank advantage formerly included in C10)
rows.evidence: RM_TwilightSea.xml lists RM_Gloamurn and RM_HoolimbrePlant as ordinary wild plants. RM_TwilightUnderstorey.xml gives the RM_BankSilt wildTerrainTags gate to decorative RM_Weircomb. No bank-specific harvestable spawn weighting was found in TerminalBiomes source.
rows.called_by: Proposed Twilight natural wild-plant seeding and replenishment under R15.
rows.serves: The reason ordinary foragers choose the current’s bank over other gathering ground.
rows.why: delegated: Without an actual forage advantage over other reachable ground, including off-bank lit gardens, the current does not tempt workers to gather beside it. The existing plants remain in C10.

rows.serves: Campaign reveal of tended gardens and peaceful inhabited bottom dwellings
